authority: Exactly one NativeUse record (net set, history, version) in one of at most eight independent maps. No global authoritative map or global resource index. Trees remain controller metadata.
owner_rule: Lowest set bit of complete immutable electrical-node SLR membership. Shared boundary resources are not cloned; membership remains unchanged for topology/search.
layout: Copied policy identity and immutable topology provider; copies deep-copy shard records. Swap exchanges layout, shards and trees together. Timing controller rejects candidate layout changes. Checkpoint import accepts explicit layout.
publication: All path/edge/depth/overflow checks, allocation and owner routing precede any authoritative write. Per-owner staged map nodes then transfer/swap without allocation or callbacks, followed by tree-node publication. Serial logical atomicity only.
ripup: Preflight all affected records and save direct pointers before erasing any owner net; retain root and empty history/version tombstones.
negotiation: Check every shard and construct pending-net set before changing any history/version.
export: Canonical global node order via at-most-eight-way iterator merge; owner_usage.csv enumerates actual maps in owner/node/net order, including tombstones.
shadow: Existing immutable boundary summaries and source-observer read validation. This change does not implement stage-local observers or a distributed network.
